sin.name: supervisor-service-verb
sin.description: The journal asks the supervisor to start or stop a service: the journal server is one of the supervisor's services and knows nothing of what the supervisor runs beside it.
sin.rule: Name the service on its feature (Feature.services), which the journal's boot asks the supervisor to start, so an upgrade brings it without a new launch; never start or stop one from anywhere else. The features' services (service_start.py), the plugin services and the tunnel are the named exceptions.
